de.abas.erp.db.selection

Interface RowSelection<HEAD extends AbasObject,ROW extends SelectableRecord & RowRecord>

  • Type Parameters:
    HEAD - Head type
    ROW - Row type
    All Superinterfaces:
    Selection<ROW>

    public interface RowSelection<HEAD extends AbasObject,ROW extends SelectableRecord & RowRecord>
extends Selection<ROW>
    A RowSelection instance represents a selection of rows in the database. Use this selection to narrow query results by conditions for head and rows.
